G5119.def: the when, i.e. at the time that (of the past or future, also in consecution)

G5147.def: akin to , , and the base of G5131 (τράγος), G5134 (τραῦμα)); a rut or worn track

G5160.def: nourishment (literally or figuratively); by implication, rations (wages)

G5101.gloss: every man, how (much), + no(-ne, thing), what (manner, thing), where (-by, -fore, -of, -unto, - with, -withal), whether…
G5101.def: an interrogative pronoun, who, which or what (in direct or indirect questions)

G5100.gloss: a (kind of), any (man, thing, thing at all), certain (thing), divers, he (every) man, one (X thing), ought, + partly, s…
G5100.def: some or any person or object

G5142.def: but perhaps strengthened from the base of G5157 (τροπή) through the idea of convolution); properly, to stiffen, i.e. fatten (by implication, to cherish (with food, etc.), pamper, rear)

G5146.def: properly, a crow-foot (three-pronged obstruction in war), i.e. (by analogy) a thorny plant (caltrop)

G5118.gloss: as large, so great (long, many, much), these many
G5118.def: apparently from G3588 (ὁ) and G3739 (ὅς)) and G3778 (οὗτος) (including its variations); so vast as this, i.e. such (in quantity, amount, number of space)

G5108.def: truly this, i.e. of this sort (to denote character or individuality)

G5185.def: opaque (as if smoky), i.e. (by analogy) blind (physically or mentally)

G5199.def: healthy, i.e. well (in body); figuratively, true (in doctrine)

G5188.def: to make a smoke, i.e. slowly consume without flame

G5117.gloss: coast, licence, place, X plain, quarter, + rock, room, where
G5117.def: a spot (general in space, but limited by occupancy; whereas G5561 (χώρα) is a large but participle locality), i.e. location (as a position, home, tract, etc.); figuratively, condition, opportunity; specially, a scabbard

G5132.def: a table or stool (as being four-legged), usually for food (figuratively, a meal); also a counter for money (figuratively, a broker's office for loans at interest)

G5154.def: third; neuter (as noun) a third part, or (as adverb) a (or the) third time, thirdly

G5111.def: probably itself from the base of G5056 (τέλος) through the idea of extreme conduct); to venture (objectively or in act; while G2292 (θαῤῥέω) is rather subjective or in feeling); by implication, to be courageous

G5176.def: or perhaps rather of a base of G5167 (τρυγών) and G5149 (τρίζω) through the idea of a craunching sound; to gnaw or chew, i.e. (generally) to eat

G5180.def: to "thump", i.e. cudgel or pummel (properly, with a stick or bastinado), but in any case by repeated blows; thus differing from G3817 (παίω) and G3960 (πατάσσω), which denote a (usually single) blow with the hand or any instrument, or G4141 (πλήσσω) with the fist (or a hammer), or G4474 (ῥαπίζω) with the palm; as well as from G5177 (τυγχάνω), an accidental collision); by implication, to punish; figuratively, to offend (the conscience)

G5110.def: interest on money loaned (as a produce)

G5143.def: compare G2359 (θρίξ)); which uses (the base of G1408 (δρόμος)) as alternate in certain tenses; to run or walk hastily (literally or figuratively)

G5168.def: akin to the base of G5134 (τραῦμα), G5147 (τρίβος) and G5176 (τρώγω)); an orifice, i.e. needle's eye

G5167.def: akin to G5149 (τρίζω), but denoting a duller sound); a turtle-dove (as cooing)

G5139.def: rough district; Trachonitis, a region of Syria

G5198.gloss: be in health, (be safe and) sound, (be) whole(-some)
G5198.def: to have sound health, i.e. be well (in body); figuratively, to be uncorrupt (true in doctrine)

G5134.def: akin to the base of G2352 (θραύω), G5147 (τρίβος), G5149 (τρίζω), etc.); a wound

G5186.def: to make blind, i.e. (figuratively) to obscure

G5179.gloss: en-(ex-)ample, fashion, figure, form, manner, pattern, print
G5179.def: a die (as struck), i.e. (by implication) a stamp or scar; by analogy, a shape, i.e. a statue, (figuratively) style or resemblance; specially, a sampler ("type"), i.e. a model (for imitation) or instance (for warning)

G5183.def: a Tyrian, i.e. inhabitant of Tyrus

G5174.def: the Troad (or plain of Troy), i.e. Troas, a place in Asia Minor

G5177.gloss: be, chance, enjoy, little, obtain, X refresh…self, + special
G5177.def: akin to the base of G5088 (τίκτω) through the idea of effecting; properly, to affect; or (specially), to hit or light upon (as a mark to be reached), i.e. (transitively) to attain or secure an object or end, or (intransitively) to happen (as if meeting with); but in the latter application only impersonal (with G1487 (εἰ)), i.e. perchance; or (present participle) as adjective, usual (as if commonly met with, with G3756 (οὐ), extraordinary), neuter (as adverb) perhaps; or (with another verb) as adverb, by accident (as it were)

G5190.def: fortuitous, i.e. fortunate; Tychicus, a Christian

G5158.gloss: (even) as, conversation, (+ like) manner, (+ by any) means, way
G5158.def: a turn, i.e. (by implication) mode or style (especially with preposition or relative prefix as adverb, like); figuratively, deportment or character

G5187.gloss: high-minded, be lifted up with pride, be proud
G5187.def: to envelop with smoke, i.e. (figuratively) to inflate with self-conceit

G5114.def: more comprehensive or decisive than G2875 (κόπτω), as if by a single stroke; whereas that implies repeated blows, like hacking); more keen

G5136.def: to seize by the throat or neck, i.e. to expose the gullet of a victim for killing (generally, to lay bare)

G5178.def: to stretch on an instrument of torture resembling a drum, and thus beat to death

G5163.def: a track (as a wheel-rut), i.e. (figuratively) a course of conduct

G5164.def: a wheel (as a runner), i.e. (figuratively) a circuit of physical effects

G5115.def: a bow (apparently as the simplest fabric)
